name: okareta
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from the footpath before the house, about 18 m from its front and north-east of its middle, looking up 9 degrees through a lens of about 45 degrees across; its camera is fitted to the front eave of the house's north-east part, to the north-east eave of its south-west wing and that eave's front end, and to the upright front edge of that wing's north-east side, with the camera held 1.6 m over the LiDAR's ground and the principal point at the centre.

building.title: Okareta (215), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 215's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 215 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline

ground_note: 36.16 m: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the first crop, 25 m round the outline (p5 25.28, p95 37.15: the ground falls about 11 m to the underpass and the gully on one side); provisional, to be the LiDAR's ground at the door at step 7

light.note: estimated: the photograph has no date; its front stands mostly in the street trees' shade, with patches of sun through the leaves. The viewer's sun behind the house (200 deg round, 40 up) leaves the front in shade: the building's luma p50 151 at an exposure of 1.0, 134 at 0.8, 125 at 0.7, against the photograph's 126; with the sun on the front (330 deg, 40 up) 218 at 1.0 and 198 at 0.55, the lit ochre near white
